correctness.rationale: Exact differentiation of F=w-(b/4)(x+z) along system (2) yields -b/4. The affine drift rules out bounded forward-complete trajectories for b nonzero. The compact positive-invariance and compactly supported stationary-measure conclusions follow by boundedness and invariance of the first moment, respectively. The b=0 case and modified follow-up vector field are excluded.

limitations: Applies only to the exact 2021 printed autonomous equations and b nonzero; a is arbitrary.

value.rationale: This exact structural obstruction corrects the interpretation of a published four-dimensional chaos model throughout its full nonzero-b parameter domain, rather than merely disputing a finite simulation. It has concrete importance because the original article and a later network-control paper describe bounded attractor behavior for the same autonomous node equations. The calculation is elementary, but its model-level consequence is substantial.
